data.desc: SHF Holdings Inc, operating as Safe Harbor Financial, is a fintech and financial services company focused on providing banking, lending, and compliance solutions to regulated cannabis businesses and financial institutions serving the cannabis sector. Through its proprietary platform, the company offers deposit services, cash management, commercial lending, payment processing, and regulatory compliance support. SHF helps cannabis-related businesses gain access to secure and compliant financial infrastructure in a highly regulated environment. Recent updates highlighted loan portfolio growth, board expansion, and continued efforts to strengthen profitability and deposit balances.
